remarks: Rare opportunity to own a penthouse unit in the amazing Mill River House. Quiet fourth floor unit with plenty of sunshine throughout the day! 2 bedrooms with walk-in closets, 2 full bathrooms, walk up to spacious loft and surprisingly spacious room which can serve as an office, yoga room or guest room. Two story windows allow the sun to shine through, and private balcony off of primary bedroom and living area serve as an escape to the outdoors. In unit laundry. Recent upgrades made: Brand new Stainless steel kitchen appliances: 2024, Installed new HVAC system: 2023, Security camera & doorbell: 2023, Recess lights and other lighting improvements: 2022, Bedroom ceiling fans: 2022, Drinking water filter system: 2023  Awesome club room and fully loaded fitness room is on 1st floor where you can also access the private garden area with picnic tables and grills for residents to enjoy the outdoors. Building is equipped with front door lobby and private parking garage; unit spot is steps away from building door. Superb location in Stamford just a short walk to mall, library, and transportation. Nearby Mill River Park features year-round food truck festivals, concerts, outdoor movies, outdoor ice skating rink, walking/jogging trails, carousel & much more. New Mill River Greenway w/walking/jogging biking trails leads to Scalzi park w/plenty of public amenities (tennis, bocce).
